source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Is the gap in possible transitions, the fact vocabulary, or the choice to admit?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Read the initial state, enabled transitions and fixed positive-rule contract.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: Compare separate futures {a} and {b} with a reachable {a,b}; replay the activating transition.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: A theorem about a supplied reachable family proves the family matches an adapter.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Repeat the same decision on one observed adapter incident; retain state, observation and authority separately.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Independent all-state oracle agrees with provider admission and witness replay; model/version mismatch rejects; operational conformance remains an explicit next obligation.

skills: ai-introduction-educator: demo failure and complexity ladder
source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Is the statement a lower bound, an attainable code, or a decision-loss result?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Specify N,k,m, allowed messages, prior/loss and budget allocation.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: N=4,k=1,m=2 with one bit selecting {1,2} or {3,4}; then compare equal-budget pooling floors.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: A one-bit message always requires opening everything, or a lower-bound ratio measures achieved savings.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Fade one step into a Check, then trace a changed message contract, then leave attainable optimal coding as an Open obligation.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Preserve the counterexample; any replacement has complete hypotheses and independent feasible-code comparison; never manufacture the requested false corollary.

source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Does the sanction apply in punishment, and what does q mean?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Define stage payoffs, public observation, reset policy and tie behavior.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: At t=.5 and delta=.19 compare all-false-action forfeiture with punishment-exempt forfeiture.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: Adding qb only to one payoff leaves the repeated game and punishment incentives otherwise unchanged.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Check every punishment state, then change the monitoring model and restate what no longer follows.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Model-specific frontier, all-state deviation checks and equality treatment accompany the claim; no unbounded or imperfect-monitoring proof inferred from finite tests.

source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Is the operation a sequential current-balance transfer or a simultaneous batch?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Specify per-source balances, child budgets and atomic debit.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: One unit copied to two .9 children gives1.8; compare a budgeted split and the actual sequential code.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: Conservation of credit alone proves coalition Sybil-proof incentives.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Trace migration with an unresolved external effect and verify both accounting and authority independently.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Source/child row sums and atomicity are explicit; correct implementation and misleading wording are classified separately; one-fork mutant is not called a shortest two-fork trace.

source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Does a cut remove a reader prerequisite or a required boundary?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Identify the audience, first treatment and downstream use of the concept.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: For one section, show a full example, a last-step Check, a Trace and an explicit Open obligation.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: Fixed page, theorem or exercise counts establish learning quality.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Ask the same concept again in a later chapter from its new application.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: A cold reader can answer from the supplied chapter; prerequisites, hypotheses and later reuse remain intact; no arbitrary quota is adopted.

source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Does the artifact record work as performed or only a documented procedure?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Freeze task population, provenance, baseline, consent/authority and missingness.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: Replay one concrete incident with observed cues, decision alternatives and independently adjudicated outcome.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: A filled ledger or model-generated grade is measured operational success.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Use the incident to design a held-out task and a counterexample control before collecting broader data.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Separate domain constraints, conceptual claims and decision cues; ground truth and equal budgets are independent; human/cloud/runtime studies require their stated prerequisites.

skills: technical-evangelism-for-formal-systems: precise scope and no straw-man comparisons
source_skill_acceptance.decision_point: Are observations raw signed claims, edge differences or typed packets?
source_skill_acceptance.prerequisite: Fix fact/schema/snapshot identity, error grouping and admitted evidence.
source_skill_acceptance.worked_example: Compare a cycle residual and direct claim checker on identical admitted receipts, including a consistent false account.
source_skill_acceptance.misconception: A residual names the lying agent or adds information absent from the inputs.
source_skill_acceptance.reuse: Choose an additional observation against a declared fault objective and price it.
source_skill_acceptance.acceptance: Equal-information direct baseline, categorical oracle and independently known incident truth precede any detection or utility claim.
